ta.cdl_doji.name: Doji
ta.cdl_doji.summary: Compare the body with the preceding window's range to identify small-bodied candles; a positive value denotes a doji, not a bullish signal.

ta.cdl_inside.name: Inside bar
ta.cdl_inside.summary: Identify candles whose high-low range lies inside the previous bar; the score sign denotes the current candle's direction.

ta.cdl_pattern.name: Pattern dispatcher
ta.cdl_pattern.summary: Batch candlestick-pattern dispatch is not available; use the individually reviewed cdl_ entries in the catalog.

ta.cdl_z.name: Candle z-score
ta.cdl_z.summary: Standardize open, high, low, and close separately to measure each price's deviation from its rolling mean.

ta.ha.name: Heikin-Ashi
ta.ha.summary: Transform OHLC into smoothed candles; the outputs are not original traded prices.

ta.dsp.name: Detrended synthetic price
ta.dsp.summary: Remove the price trend component to examine the remaining cyclical fluctuations.

ta.ebsw.name: Even Better Sine Wave
ta.ebsw.summary: Use a filtered waveform to examine cycle states; the output oscillates within a bounded range.

ta.ht_dcperiod.name: Hilbert dominant cycle period
ta.ht_dcperiod.summary: Estimate the length of the dominant price cycle to examine changes in its period.

ta.ht_dcphase.name: Hilbert dominant cycle phase
ta.ht_dcphase.summary: Estimate the dominant cycle phase for cycle analysis.

ta.ht_phasor.name: Hilbert phasor
ta.ht_phasor.summary: Provide in-phase and quadrature components to describe cycle phase relationships.

ta.ht_sine.name: Hilbert sine wave
ta.ht_sine.summary: Output sine and leading-sine components to compare cycle phases.

ta.ht_trendmode.name: Hilbert trend mode
ta.ht_trendmode.summary: Distinguish trend and cycle market regimes using a state value.

ta.msw.name: Mesa Sine Wave
ta.msw.summary: Estimate phase over the recent window and generate sine and leading-sine components; period must exceed one.

ta.ao.name: Awesome Oscillator
ta.ao.summary: Compare fast and slow averages of the midpoint price to examine momentum direction and changes.

ta.apo.name: Absolute Price Oscillator
ta.apo.summary: Compute the absolute difference between fast and slow moving averages, retaining the price scale.

ta.bias.name: Bias
ta.bias.summary: Measure the proportional deviation of price from its moving average.

ta.bop.name: Balance of Power
ta.bop.summary: Describe the current candle's price pressure through the relationship between the open-close difference and high-low range.

ta.brar.name: BRAR sentiment indicators
ta.brar.summary: Measure upward and downward pressure relative to the open and previous close separately.

ta.cci.name: Commodity Channel Index
ta.cci.summary: Standardize price deviation by mean deviation to measure the distance from the mean.

ta.cfo.name: Chande Forecast Oscillator
ta.cfo.summary: Compare actual price with the regression forecast to examine forecast deviation.

ta.cg.name: Center of Gravity Oscillator
ta.cg.summary: Use the weighted center of gravity of window prices to describe turning patterns.

ta.cmo.name: Chande Momentum Oscillator
ta.cmo.summary: Compare gains and losses within the window to measure net momentum.

ta.coppock.name: Coppock Curve
ta.coppock.summary: Smooth a combination of rates of change at different periods to examine longer-term momentum.

ta.cti.name: Correlation Trend Indicator
ta.cti.summary: Measure how closely window prices follow a linear trend.

ta.dm.name: Directional movement
ta.dm.summary: Compute positive and negative directional movement separately; read the two channels individually.

ta.er.name: Efficiency ratio
ta.er.summary: Compare net change with cumulative movement to examine directionality and noise along the path.

ta.eri.name: Elder Ray Index
ta.eri.summary: Compute high and low distances from a moving average to represent bull and bear power separately.

ta.fisher.name: Fisher Transform
ta.fisher.summary: Transform normalized prices and provide a main line and signal line.

ta.fosc.name: Forecast Oscillator
ta.fosc.summary: Compute the relative difference between the actual close and the one-step-ahead regression forecast.

ta.inertia.name: Inertia
ta.inertia.summary: Apply linear-regression smoothing to the relative volatility index RVI to examine slower changes.

ta.kdj.name: KDJ stochastic indicator
ta.kdj.summary: Form K, D, and derived J lines from the stochastic position and smoothed values.

ta.kst.name: Know Sure Thing
ta.kst.summary: Combine and smooth rates of change at different periods, providing a main line and signal line.

ta.lrsi.name: Laguerre RSI
ta.lrsi.summary: Construct a relative-strength series with Laguerre filtering; parameters control smoothing.

ta.macd.name: Moving Average Convergence Divergence
ta.macd.summary: The fast-minus-slow EMA difference forms the main line; the signal smooths that line, and the histogram is their difference.

ta.macdext.name: Extended MACD
ta.macdext.summary: Allow different moving-average types for the fast, slow, and signal lines.

ta.macdfix.name: Fixed-period MACD
ta.macdfix.summary: Fix the fast and slow periods at 12 and 26; only the signal period is adjustable.

ta.mom.name: Momentum difference
ta.mom.summary: Compute the difference between current price and the historical price at the specified interval.

ta.pgo.name: Pretty Good Oscillator
ta.pgo.summary: Measure the distance from price to its simple moving average in units of average true range.

ta.po.name: Projection Oscillator
ta.po.summary: Measure price deviation from a linear-regression trend.

ta.ppo.name: Percentage Price Oscillator
ta.ppo.summary: Normalize the fast-minus-slow moving-average difference as a percentage and provide signal and histogram values.

ta.psl.name: Psychological Line
ta.psl.summary: Count the fraction of rising periods within the window to examine how frequently gains occur.

ta.pvo.name: Percentage Volume Oscillator
ta.pvo.summary: Compare fast and slow volume moving averages, providing main, signal, and histogram channels.

ta.qqe.name: Quantitative Qualitative Estimation
ta.qqe.summary: Construct dynamic bands and directional states from smoothed RSI; the long and short bands have sparse outputs.

ta.roc.name: Percentage rate of change
ta.roc.summary: Compute price change over the specified interval and express it as a percentage.

ta.rocp.name: Fractional rate of change
ta.rocp.summary: Compute the proportional price change without multiplying by one hundred.

ta.rocr.name: Price ratio
ta.rocr.summary: Compute the ratio of current price to the specified historical price; one denotes no change.

ta.rocr100.name: Price ratio on a percentage scale
ta.rocr100.summary: Multiply the price ratio by one hundred; one hundred denotes no change.

ta.rsi.name: Relative Strength Index
ta.rsi.summary: Compare smoothed gains and losses to examine price momentum.

ta.rsx.name: Smoothed relative strength
ta.rsx.summary: Use multistage smoothing to form a relative-strength series; the algorithm differs from ordinary RSI.

ta.rvgi.name: Relative Vigor Index
ta.rvgi.summary: Compare open-close changes with high-low ranges, providing main, signal, and difference channels.

ta.slope.name: Change slope
ta.slope.summary: Compute the slope over the specified interval, optionally expressed as an angle.

ta.smc_sweep.name: Liquidity sweep
ta.smc_sweep.summary: Identify rejection patterns after crossing local high or low levels; this does not observe order-book liquidity.

ta.smi.name: SMI Ergodic
ta.smi.summary: Form main, signal, and difference channels from doubly smoothed momentum; this differs from stochastic momentum SMI.

ta.squeeze.name: Squeeze
ta.squeeze.summary: Compare Bollinger Bands with Keltner Channels and combine momentum with compression and release states.

ta.squeeze_pro.name: Multilevel Squeeze
ta.squeeze_pro.summary: Provide squeeze states and momentum for different channel widths; read state channels individually.

ta.stc.name: Schaff Trend Cycle
ta.stc.summary: Apply successive stochastic normalization and smoothing to MACD to form cycle readings.

ta.stoch.name: Stochastic Oscillator
ta.stoch.summary: Measure the close's position within the recent high-low range, providing smoothed K and D lines.

ta.stochf.name: Fast Stochastic Oscillator
ta.stochf.summary: Provide a less-smoothed stochastic K line and its D line.

ta.stochrsi.name: Stochastic RSI
ta.stochrsi.summary: Normalize RSI within a window and provide K and D lines.

ta.td_seq.name: TD Sequential count
ta.td_seq.summary: Accumulate upward and downward sequence counts by comparing historical prices; no trading outcome is guaranteed.

ta.trix.name: Triple-smoothed rate of change
ta.trix.summary: Compute the rate of change after triple exponential smoothing and provide a signal line.

ta.trixh.name: Triple-smoothed histogram
ta.trixh.summary: Output the difference between TRIX and its signal line in addition to both lines.

ta.tsi.name: True Strength Index
ta.tsi.summary: Double-smooth momentum and absolute momentum, providing strength and signal values.

ta.uo.name: Ultimate Oscillator
ta.uo.summary: Combine buying-pressure-to-true-range relationships across multiple periods to examine momentum.

ta.vwmacd.name: Volume-weighted MACD
ta.vwmacd.summary: Replace ordinary fast and slow averages with volume-weighted averages, outputting main, signal, and histogram channels.

ta.willr.name: Williams Percent Range
ta.willr.summary: Measure the close's position relative to the window's highest and lowest prices.

ta.alma.name: Arnaud Legoux Moving Average
ta.alma.summary: Smooth price with an offsettable Gaussian weight distribution to control smoothing and response. floor=True rounds the weight center down and normalizes stably; the fixed backend weight direction is retained, without promising numerical parity with Pine.

ta.avgprice.name: Average OHLC price
ta.avgprice.summary: Compute the arithmetic mean of open, high, low, and close.

ta.dema.name: Double Exponential Moving Average
ta.dema.summary: Combine first- and second-level EMAs to reduce lag introduced by ordinary smoothing.

ta.ema.name: Exponential Moving Average
ta.ema.summary: Give recent prices greater weight to smooth price and examine trends; the default seed is a simple average.

ta.fwma.name: Fibonacci Weighted Moving Average
ta.fwma.summary: Smooth window prices using Fibonacci weights.

ta.hilo.name: Gann High Low Activator
ta.hilo.summary: Combine high and low moving averages to form levels and direction outputs that switch with the trend.

ta.hl2.name: High-low midpoint
ta.hl2.summary: Compute the mean of high and low.

ta.hlc3.name: Typical price
ta.hlc3.summary: Compute the mean of high, low, and close.

ta.hma.name: Hull Moving Average
ta.hma.summary: Combine weighted averages of different window lengths to smooth price and reduce lag.

ta.ht_trendline.name: Hilbert trendline
ta.ht_trendline.summary: Use cycle estimation to form a smoothed trendline.

ta.hwma.name: Holt-Winters Moving Average
ta.hwma.summary: Smooth prices using recursively updated components such as level and trend.

ta.ichimoku.name: Ichimoku
ta.ichimoku.summary: Provide conversion, base, and same-index cloud lines; no future extension or lagging line is output.

ta.jma.name: Jurik-style Moving Average
ta.jma.summary: Examine price trends through adaptive smoothing; this implementation does not promise exact equivalence with other platforms.

ta.kama.name: Kaufman Adaptive Moving Average
ta.kama.summary: Use the efficiency ratio to adjust smoothing speed and distinguish directional change from noise.

ta.linreg.name: Linear regression value
ta.linreg.summary: Fit a rolling linear trend and read its regression value. offset selects position length-1-offset on the current window's fitted line, permitting negative extrapolation; it does not shift the result series, and length=1 remains invalid.

ta.linregangle.name: Linear regression angle
ta.linregangle.summary: Convert the linear-regression slope to an angle.

ta.linregintercept.name: Linear regression intercept
ta.linregintercept.summary: Output the intercept of the rolling linear fit.

ta.linregslope.name: Linear regression slope
ta.linregslope.summary: Output the per-step slope of the rolling linear fit.

ta.ma.name: Selectable moving average
ta.ma.summary: Compute a smoothed value using the specified moving-average type; available types are constrained by the parameter domain.

ta.mama.name: Mesa Adaptive Moving Average
ta.mama.summary: Adjust smoothing speed according to cycle-phase changes and provide a following moving average.

ta.mavp.name: Variable-period Moving Average
ta.mavp.summary: Use a caller-supplied per-bar periods series to vary the moving-average window within the permitted range.

ta.mcgd.name: McGinley Dynamic
ta.mcgd.summary: Adjust recursive smoothing according to the distance between price and the dynamic line.

ta.medprice.name: Median price
ta.medprice.summary: Compute the high-low mean for subsequent price transformations and smoothing.

ta.midpoint.name: Window midpoint
ta.midpoint.summary: Compute the midpoint of the maximum and minimum within a window of one input series.

ta.midprice.name: Window high-low midpoint
ta.midprice.summary: Compute the midpoint of the highest high and lowest low within the window.

ta.mmar.name: Madrid moving-average ribbon
ta.mmar.summary: Compute moving averages at different periods simultaneously to examine their ordering and spacing.

ta.ohlc4.name: OHLC average
ta.ohlc4.summary: Compute the average of the four OHLC prices for use as a composite indicator input.

ta.pwma.name: Pascal Weighted Moving Average
ta.pwma.summary: Smooth the window using Pascal triangle weights.

ta.rainbow.name: Rainbow moving-average ribbon
ta.rainbow.summary: Repeatedly average the previous smoothing stage to output multiple moving-average layers.

ta.rma.name: Wilder Moving Average
ta.rma.summary: Use a Wilder smoothing coefficient related to window length.

ta.sinwma.name: Sine Weighted Moving Average
ta.sinwma.summary: Smooth window prices using sine weights.

ta.sma.name: Simple Moving Average
ta.sma.summary: Compute the arithmetic mean of recent window prices with equal weight for each sample.

ta.ssf.name: Super Smoother Filter
ta.ssf.summary: Use recursive filtering with the specified pole count to reduce high-frequency price fluctuations.

ta.supertrend.name: Supertrend
ta.supertrend.summary: Construct trend-following levels from average true range, providing direction and long/short levels.

ta.swma.name: Symmetric Weighted Moving Average
ta.swma.summary: Smooth the series with symmetric triangular weights; window length is configurable.

ta.t3.name: T3 Moving Average
ta.t3.summary: Combine multistage EMAs with a volume factor to form a smoothed trendline.

ta.tema.name: Triple Exponential Moving Average
ta.tema.summary: Combine first-, second-, and third-level EMAs to reduce smoothing lag.

ta.tsf.name: Time Series Forecast
ta.tsf.summary: Compute a one-step-ahead forecast from window linear regression without reading future prices.

ta.typprice.name: Typical price
ta.typprice.summary: Average high, low, and close into a single channel.

ta.vidya.name: Variable Index Dynamic Average
ta.vidya.summary: Adjust the EMA smoothing coefficient using relative momentum.

ta.vwap.name: Volume Weighted Average Price
ta.vwap.summary: Accumulate price and volume within groups defined by the datetime index; exchange sessions are not inferred automatically.

ta.vwma.name: Volume Weighted Moving Average
ta.vwma.summary: Weight prices by volume within a rolling window.

ta.wcp.name: Weighted Close Price
ta.wcp.summary: Compute the weighted average of high, low, and twice the close.

ta.wma.name: Linear Weighted Moving Average
ta.wma.summary: Apply linear weights to window prices.

ta.zlma.name: Zero-lag Moving Average
ta.zlma.summary: Apply lag compensation before smoothing to examine a faster-responding trend value.

ta.drawdown.name: Drawdown series
ta.drawdown.summary: Compute price drawdown relative to historical peaks, outputting channels at different scales.

ta.log_return.name: Log return
ta.log_return.summary: Compute the logarithm of price ratios, optionally cumulatively.

ta.percent_return.name: Fractional return
ta.percent_return.summary: Compute relative price changes, optionally cumulatively; the output definition determines the precise scale.

ta.beta.name: Rolling beta
ta.beta.summary: Compare joint changes of price and a benchmark series; the caller must supply a benchmark on the same calendar.

ta.correl.name: Rolling correlation
ta.correl.summary: Measure linear correlation between two price series on the same calendar.

ta.entropy.name: Rolling entropy
ta.entropy.summary: Compute information content from the relative distribution within the window to examine distribution changes.

ta.kurtosis.name: Rolling kurtosis
ta.kurtosis.summary: Measure tail and peak characteristics of the window distribution.

ta.mad.name: Mean Absolute Deviation
ta.mad.summary: Compute the mean absolute deviation of window samples from their mean.

ta.md.name: Mean Deviation
ta.md.summary: Compute the mean absolute deviation of window samples from their mean; the current implementation calls MAD.

ta.median.name: Rolling median
ta.median.summary: Read the middle of the window distribution to reduce the influence of extreme values.

ta.quantile.name: Rolling quantile
ta.quantile.summary: Read the window statistic at the quantile specified by the parameter.

ta.skew.name: Rolling skewness
ta.skew.summary: Measure asymmetry of the window distribution.

ta.stderr.name: Standard error of the mean
ta.stderr.summary: Estimate uncertainty of the mean using sample standard deviation and window length.

ta.stdev.name: Rolling standard deviation
ta.stdev.summary: Measure dispersion of window prices; the parameter determines degrees of freedom.

ta.tos_stdevall.name: Full-range standard deviation reference
ta.tos_stdevall.summary: A research entry dependent on full-range statistics; unavailable as a causal bar-by-bar indicator.

ta.variance.name: Rolling variance
ta.variance.summary: Compute window dispersion on a squared scale.

ta.zscore.name: Rolling z-score
ta.zscore.summary: Standardize price deviation using the mean and standard deviation.

ta.adx.name: Average Directional Index
ta.adx.summary: Smooth directional-movement strength and provide positive and negative direction channels; strength itself does not denote direction.

ta.adxr.name: Average Directional Index Rating
ta.adxr.summary: Combine current and lagged ADX to further smooth trend strength.

ta.amat.name: Archer Moving Average Trend
ta.amat.summary: Compare changes in fast and slow moving averages to output bullish and bearish trend states.

ta.aroon.name: Aroon
ta.aroon.summary: Measure the time since recent highs and lows, outputting up, down, and difference channels.

ta.chop.name: Choppiness Index
ta.chop.summary: Combine cumulative true range with the price range to distinguish trending and ranging characteristics.

ta.cksp.name: Chande Kroll Stop
ta.cksp.summary: Form long and short reference stop levels from price extremes and volatility.

ta.cpr.name: Central Pivot Range
ta.cpr.summary: Compute the pivot and support/resistance using only the previous input bar; no cross-timeframe aggregation is automatic.

ta.decay.name: Signal decay
ta.decay.summary: Propagate historical signals forward using the selected decay mode.

ta.decreasing.name: Decreasing test
ta.decreasing.summary: Test whether input decreases over the specified period, optionally requiring consecutive decreases.

ta.dpo.name: Detrended Price Oscillator
ta.dpo.summary: Remove the moving-average trend; the current mode is fixed as non-centered and without lookahead.

ta.dx.name: Directional Index
ta.dx.summary: Compute trend strength from the relative difference between positive and negative directional movement.

ta.edecay.name: Exponential decay
ta.edecay.summary: Recursively decay historical series values while remaining constrained by the current input.

ta.increasing.name: Increasing test
ta.increasing.summary: Test whether input increases over the specified period, optionally requiring consecutive increases.

ta.long_run.name: Long trend phase
ta.long_run.summary: Identify bullish phases from rising and falling relationships of fast and slow series.

ta.minus_dm.name: Negative directional movement
ta.minus_dm.summary: Smooth downward directional movement; it is not yet normalized into the negative directional index.

ta.plus_dm.name: Positive directional movement
ta.plus_dm.summary: Smooth upward directional movement; it is not yet normalized into the positive directional index.

ta.pmax.name: Price Maximizer stop
ta.pmax.summary: Combine moving averages and true range to generate dynamic trend reference levels.

ta.psar.name: Parabolic SAR
ta.psar.summary: Recursively track trends and reversals, providing long/short levels, acceleration factors, and reversal flags.

ta.qstick.name: Qstick
ta.qstick.summary: Smooth the close-minus-open difference to examine the average candle-body direction.

ta.sarext.name: Extended Parabolic SAR
ta.sarext.summary: Control acceleration parameters separately for long and short phases.

ta.short_run.name: Short trend phase
ta.short_run.summary: Identify bearish phases from directional changes of fast and slow series.

ta.tsignals.name: Trend events
ta.tsignals.summary: Convert input trend states into trading changes, entry events, and exit events.

ta.ttm_trend.name: TTM Trend
ta.ttm_trend.summary: Compare the close with recent average price levels to provide trend direction.

ta.vhf.name: Vertical Horizontal Filter
ta.vhf.summary: Compare the price range with cumulative changes to examine concentration of directional movement.

ta.vortex.name: Vortex Indicator
ta.vortex.summary: Measure positive and negative trend movement separately.

ta.xsignals.name: Threshold-crossing events
ta.xsignals.summary: Convert input signal threshold crossings into trend, entry, and exit events.

ta.aberration.name: Aberration volatility channel
ta.aberration.summary: Construct upper and lower channels around smoothed prices and output true range.

ta.accbands.name: Acceleration Bands
ta.accbands.summary: Adjust upper and lower envelopes using the price range, then smooth them.

ta.atr.name: Average True Range
ta.atr.summary: Smooth true ranges including gap effects to measure the scale of volatility.

ta.avolume.name: Annualized historical volatility
ta.avolume.summary: Scale the population standard deviation of log returns by a fixed annualization factor; this is not a volume indicator.

ta.bbands.name: Bollinger Bands
ta.bbands.summary: Construct upper and lower bands around a moving average using standard deviation, providing bandwidth and relative position.

ta.ce.name: Chandelier Exit
ta.ce.summary: Form long and short exit reference levels from price extremes and ATR.

ta.cvi.name: Chaikin Volatility
ta.cvi.summary: Examine the rate of change of the smoothed high-low range.

ta.donchian.name: Donchian Channel
ta.donchian.summary: Read the rolling highest high and lowest low and provide the channel midpoint.

ta.hvol.name: Historical volatility
ta.hvol.summary: Compute annualized standard deviation of window log returns.

ta.hwc.name: Holt-Winters Channel
ta.hwc.summary: Construct upper and lower channels around Holt-Winters smoothed values.

ta.kc.name: Keltner Channel
ta.kc.summary: Construct channels around a moving average using price range or true range. use_true_range=False uses smoothed H-L ranges; it does not change the price moving average or ATR, and all parameters still follow the fixed backend.

ta.massi.name: Mass Index
ta.massi.summary: Examine range expansion through a smoothed ratio of high-low ranges.

ta.natr.name: Normalized Average True Range
ta.natr.summary: Normalize ATR by the price scale to compare relative volatility.

ta.pdist.name: Price distance
ta.pdist.summary: Combine OHLC movement distances to examine current-bar price activity.

ta.rvi.name: Relative Volatility Index
ta.rvi.summary: Accumulate volatility according to rising and falling directions; this differs from relative vigor RVGI.

ta.thermo.name: Elder Thermometer
ta.thermo.summary: Examine the intensity of high and low price changes, providing temperature, smoothing, and threshold states.

ta.true_range.name: True Range
ta.true_range.summary: Take the maximum of the high-low range and gap ranges relative to the previous close. With handle_na=True, a missing previous close falls back to H-L and the current Close may be missing; non-finite or inverted H/L is invalid. The default retains the previous output.

ta.ui.name: Ulcer Index
ta.ui.summary: Measure downside volatility using mean squared drawdown, assigning greater weight to larger drawdowns.

ta.ad.name: Accumulation/Distribution Line
ta.ad.summary: Allocate volume according to the close's position within the high-low range and accumulate the result.

ta.adosc.name: Chaikin Accumulation/Distribution Oscillator
ta.adosc.summary: Compute the difference between fast and slow smoothed accumulation/distribution values.

ta.aobv.name: Archer On-Balance Volume
ta.aobv.summary: Add moving averages, range extremes, and trend states to OBV.

ta.cmf.name: Chaikin Money Flow
ta.cmf.summary: Combine the close's range position with volume to measure the window's money-flow tendency.

ta.efi.name: Elder Force Index
ta.efi.summary: Combine price change and volume to measure the force of price movement.

ta.emv.name: Raw Ease of Movement
ta.emv.summary: Measure the relationship between price-range movement and volume without subsequent smoothing.

ta.eom.name: Smoothed Ease of Movement
ta.eom.summary: Smooth the relationship between price movement and volume to examine relative ease of movement.

ta.kvo.name: Klinger Volume Oscillator
ta.kvo.summary: Combine price and volume changes, providing a main line and signal line.

ta.marketfi.name: Market Facilitation Index
ta.marketfi.summary: Measure the high-low range per unit of volume; this differs from the money-flow MFI.

ta.mfi.name: Money Flow Index
ta.mfi.summary: Combine typical price and volume to compare positive and negative money flow.

ta.nvi.name: Negative Volume Index
ta.nvi.summary: Update the index by price ratios when volume falls; missing values preserve internal state.

ta.obv.name: On-Balance Volume
ta.obv.summary: Accumulate volume according to whether prices rise or fall.

ta.pvi.name: Positive Volume Index
ta.pvi.summary: Update the index by price ratios when volume rises; missing values preserve internal state.

ta.pvol.name: Price-volume product
ta.pvol.summary: Compute the product of price and volume with optional directional handling.

ta.pvr.name: Price Volume Rank
ta.pvr.summary: Assign categorical ranks to combinations of rising/falling price and volume.

ta.pvt.name: Price Volume Trend
ta.pvt.summary: Weight volume by the price rate of change and accumulate it.

ta.vfi.name: Volume Flow Indicator
ta.vfi.summary: Combine a price-change threshold with volume to examine money-flow direction.

ta.vosc.name: Volume Oscillator
ta.vosc.summary: Normalize the fast-minus-slow volume moving-average difference by the slow average.

ta.vp.name: Volume Profile
ta.vp.summary: Aggregate volume by price ranges; unavailable because its output is not a per-bar series on the same index.

ta.wad.name: Williams Accumulation/Distribution
ta.wad.summary: Accumulate directional pressure from price changes relative to the previous close.

ta.highest.name: Window highest value
ta.highest.summary: Read the maximum valid value within the recent fixed window.

ta.lowest.name: Window lowest value
ta.lowest.summary: Read the minimum valid value within the recent fixed window.

ta.highestbars.name: Highest-value position
ta.highestbars.summary: Return the non-positive bar offset of the window maximum relative to the current bar; ties choose the rightmost position.

ta.lowestbars.name: Lowest-value position
ta.lowestbars.summary: Return the non-positive bar offset of the window minimum relative to the current bar; ties choose the rightmost position.

ta.rolling_sum.name: Rolling sum
ta.rolling_sum.summary: Compute the input sum within the recent fixed window.

ta.range.name: Window range
ta.range.summary: Compute the difference between the window maximum and minimum.

ta.percentrank.name: Percentile rank
ta.percentrank.summary: Measure the current input's relative rank within the window.

ta.rolling_count.name: Condition count
ta.rolling_count.summary: Count how often the condition holds within the window.

ta.cum.name: Cumulative sum
ta.cum.summary: Accumulate inputs in historical order; missing positions have no valid output, and subsequent valid values continue the prior total.

ta.running_max.name: Running maximum
ta.running_max.summary: Recursively record the largest value observed in history.

ta.running_min.name: Running minimum
ta.running_min.summary: Recursively record the smallest value observed in history.

ta.change.name: Interval change
ta.change.summary: Compute the difference between the current input and the value at the specified historical interval.

ta.shift.name: Historical shift
ta.shift.summary: Read input from the specified number of bars ago; future shifts are unavailable.

ta.percentile_nearest_rank.name: Nearest-rank percentile
ta.percentile_nearest_rank.summary: Read the specified window percentile using the nearest-rank rule.

ta.percentile_linear_interpolation.name: Interpolated percentile
ta.percentile_linear_interpolation.summary: Compute the specified window percentile using linear interpolation.

ta.cross.name: Bidirectional crossover series
ta.cross.summary: Mark crossings in either direction between the previous and current bars, returning a historical series.

ta.crossover.name: Crossover series
ta.crossover.summary: Mark a crossover when the current left value exceeds the right and the previous left value was less than or equal to the right; return a historical series.

ta.crossunder.name: Crossunder series
ta.crossunder.summary: Mark a crossunder when the current left value is below the right and the previous left value was greater than or equal to the right; return a historical series.

ta.barssince.name: Bars since condition
ta.barssince.summary: Count bars since the most recent true condition; no valid result exists before the first occurrence.

ta.valuewhen.name: Condition-event value
ta.valuewhen.summary: Return the input at the specified historical occurrence of a true condition; unconfirmed events are not written back into the past.

ta.rising.name: Above preceding window test
ta.rising.summary: Test whether the current value strictly exceeds the maximum of the preceding length bars; consecutive rises are not required.

ta.falling.name: Below preceding window test
ta.falling.summary: Test whether the current value is strictly below the minimum of the preceding length bars; consecutive falls are not required.

ta.pivothigh.name: Confirmed pivot high
ta.pivothigh.summary: Output the high, original position, and confirmation position after the right window completes; do not backfill the original high.

ta.pivotlow.name: Confirmed pivot low
ta.pivotlow.summary: Output the low, original position, and confirmation position after the right window completes; do not backfill the original low.

ta.smi_stochastic.name: Stochastic Momentum Index
ta.smi_stochastic.summary: Smooth the price's distance from the window midpoint and normalize by the range; this differs from SMI Ergodic.

ta.crsi.name: Connors RSI
ta.crsi.summary: Combine price RSI, consecutive-rise/fall RSI, and rate-of-change rank.

ta.pmo.name: Price Momentum Oscillator
ta.pmo.summary: Recursively smooth price momentum, providing a main line and signal line.

ta.rmi.name: Relative Momentum Index
ta.rmi.summary: Construct relative strength using momentum over the specified interval rather than only adjacent prices.

ta.alligator.name: Alligator moving averages
ta.alligator.summary: Output jaw, teeth, and lips lines with different smoothing periods; no plotting displacement is applied.

ta.gator.name: Gator Oscillator
ta.gator.summary: Examine distances between Alligator moving averages, providing upper and lower channels.

ta.atr_stop.name: ATR trailing stop
ta.atr_stop.summary: Recursively compute stop levels from price and ATR and output directional states.

ta.volatility_stop.name: Volatility trailing stop
ta.volatility_stop.summary: Recursively compute stops from volatility and direction; output starts on the bar after the first reversal, without historical backfilling.

ta.ma_envelopes.name: Moving-average envelopes
ta.ma_envelopes.summary: Set upper and lower bands at a fixed proportion on either side of the moving average.

ta.starc.name: STARC Bands
ta.starc.summary: Use a moving average as the center and ATR multiples for upper and lower bands.

ta.ac.name: Acceleration Oscillator
ta.ac.summary: Compare momentum oscillator values with their smoothed values to examine momentum's rate of change.

ta.ibs.name: Internal Bar Strength
ta.ibs.summary: Measure the close's position within the current high-low range.

ta.frama.name: Fractal Adaptive Moving Average
ta.frama.summary: Adjust smoothing speed according to the window's fractal characteristics.

ta.wavetrend.name: WaveTrend
ta.wavetrend.summary: Standardize and smooth typical-price deviation, providing a main wave line and signal line.

ta.adr.name: Average intrabar range
ta.adr.summary: Average the input bars' high-low ranges; non-daily input is not automatically converted to daily data.

ta.rvol.name: Relative volume
ta.rvol.summary: Compare current volume with recent average volume.

ta.rci.name: Rank Correlation Index
ta.rci.summary: Compare price ranks with time ranks to examine monotonic price direction within the window.

ta.iii.name: Intraday Intensity Index
ta.iii.summary: Combine the close's range position with volume to describe intraday pressure.

ta.wvad.name: Williams Variable Accumulation/Distribution
ta.wvad.summary: Weight volume by the open-close change relative to the high-low range.

ta.pivot_points.name: Confirmed period pivots
ta.pivot_points.summary: Compute support and resistance from the previous complete period marked by explicit anchor values; Woodie additionally uses the new period's open. developing=True outputs cumulative levels for the current anchored interval; the first anchor bar is immediately available, invalid OHLC contaminates values until the next anchor, and Woodie forbids developing.

ta.cdl_engulfing.name: Engulfing pattern
ta.cdl_engulfing.summary: Identify engulfing relationships between adjacent candle bodies; scores retain direction and strength.

ta.cdl_hammer.name: Hammer
ta.cdl_hammer.summary: Identify conditions such as a small body and long lower shadow, outputting a pattern score.

ta.cdl_shootingstar.name: Shooting Star
ta.cdl_shootingstar.summary: Identify conditions such as a small body and long upper shadow, outputting a pattern score.

ta.cdl_harami.name: Harami
ta.cdl_harami.summary: Identify containment relationships between consecutive bodies; scores retain direction and strength.

ta.cdl_morningstar.name: Morning Star
ta.cdl_morningstar.summary: Identify a three-candle morning-star pattern; confirmation requires the third candle.

ta.cdl_eveningstar.name: Evening Star
ta.cdl_eveningstar.summary: Identify a three-candle evening-star pattern; confirmation requires the third candle.

ta.cdl_marubozu.name: Marubozu
ta.cdl_marubozu.summary: Identify body candles with very short shadows and output a directional score.

ta.anchored_vwap.name: Condition-anchored VWAP
ta.anchored_vwap.summary: Explicit 0/1 anchors reset before including the current observation; values are invalid before the first anchor, missing source or volume is skipped, zero volume retains an existing positive-weight mean, and negative volume is rejected.

ta.anchored_vwap_bands.name: Condition-anchored VWAP bands
ta.anchored_vwap_bands.summary: The center matches condition-anchored VWAP; outer bands use the volume-weighted population standard deviation. Accumulation or output overflow raises an error.

ta.mode.name: Mode of finite observations
ta.mode.summary: Return the mode of the most recent length finite observations; ties choose the smallest, non-finite values are skipped, and missing rows retain the result after the window fills.
